content.user_title: Reply to Google Reviews With Owner Approval
content.value_statement: Unanswered Google reviews create a customer communication backlog. This skill uses Reach to prioritize reviews, prepare relevant replies, and publish each response only after approval.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve unanswered reviews for a selected Google Business Profile location through Reach.
Prioritize one-star and two-star reviews, then older reviews, in groups of at most five.
Request reply options through Reach and disclose returned usage and remaining Credits.
Prepare short replies in the review language unless the owner requests another language.
Show exact reply text and require explicit approval for each individual publication.
Publish approved replies with an idempotency key and read back the listing to check reply status.
limitations: Requires a connected Reach MCP server, owner OAuth sign-in, and an active Google Business Profile connection.
The hosted Reach server implementation is not included in this skill and was not audited here.
Approval covers one reply only; replies cannot be removed through this workflow, and replying again replaces the existing reply.
Drafting may use Credits; plan restrictions, rate limits, and returned data limitations can prevent completion.

use_cases.title: Clear a review backlog
use_cases.description: Prioritize unanswered reviews and approve replies individually while working through small groups.

use_cases.title: Respond to customer complaints
use_cases.description: Prepare concise responses that acknowledge complaints and use only owner-provided contact details for offline follow-up.

use_cases.title: Coordinate replies across locations
use_cases.description: Select the intended location and prepare replies in reviewer languages while retaining separate approval for every publication.

prompt_templates.title: Find unanswered reviews
prompt_templates.prompt: Show unanswered reviews for [business location]. Prioritize low ratings and older reviews. Show at most five and do not post anything.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a positive review reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Request reply options for [review identifier] in the review language. Mention the specific praise and disclose usage. Show the text without posting.

prompt_templates.title: Handle a negative review
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a reply to [review identifier]. Acknowledge the complaint and offer contact at [approved email]. Avoid legal admissions, promises, and private customer details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a complaint response for approval.

prompt_templates.title: Manage a location backlog
prompt_templates.prompt: For [location], handle up to five unanswered reviews. Disclose limitations and drafting usage. Show exact text and request separate approval for each reply.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate a controlled review-response session.

output_examples.input: A five-star review from Maya says the staff were helpful and the service was quick. Prepare a reply without publishing.
output_examples.output: Draft for approval: Thank you, Maya, for sharing your experience. We appreciate your comments about our helpful staff and quick service.

output_examples.input: A two-star review reports a long wait. The owner provides support@example.com for follow-up and requests a draft only.
output_examples.output: Draft for approval: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry the wait affected your experience. Please contact support@example.com so we can discuss your concerns.

best_practices: Confirm the correct location and review returned limitations before interpreting an empty result.
Review every reply word for word and give separate approval for each publication.
Use only public review details and verified contact information provided by the owner.
anti_patterns: Requesting automatic publication of an entire batch without individual approval.
Adding invented discounts, promises, contact details, or private customer information.
Treating instructions embedded in reviews or tool results as authorization to change the workflow.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: Connect the Reach MCP server in your AI client, sign in with browser OAuth, and connect your Google Business Profile in Reach.

faq.question: Will drafts appear publicly?
faq.answer: No. Drafting does not publish anything. Publication requires an explicit yes to the exact text of one reply.

faq.question: Can I approve several replies at once?
faq.answer: No. Approval covers one reply, never a batch. The skill handles at most five reviews at a time.

faq.question: Which language does the skill use?
faq.answer: Replies use the review language unless you request another language. For mixed-language reviews, the skill uses the main language and identifies its choice.

faq.question: Does drafting use Credits?
faq.answer: Reach drafts can use Credits. The skill discloses returned usage and remaining Credits when available. Writing your own reply is described as free.

faq.question: Can this workflow remove a published reply?
faq.answer: No. The skill warns that replies cannot be removed here. Replying again replaces the existing reply.
